ErrorBoundary.description: The last thing between a thrown render and a blank page.

SidebarProvider.description: Sidebar has TWO independent dimensions of state: - collapsed (desktop): icon-only rail vs.

ThemeProvider.description: Owns which theme the tree renders in — light, dark, or the reader's system setting — and writes it where CSS can read it (`data-theme` on the root).

ToastProvider.description: Owns the queue of transient messages and renders them in one place.

chart.description: The arithmetic every chart in this system shares.

composeRefs.description: Fill our own ref AND whatever ref the caller already put on the element.

formatNumber.description: One writing of a number per system.

isRouteActive.description: Is this nav route the one the user is currently inside? Every app was answering this with `pathname === route`, which is right on the list screen and wrong the moment you open something: standing on `/discovery/dg` the "Discovery" item went dark, so the sidebar claimed you were nowhere.

playgroundSettings.description: Live design-system knobs — written straight to documentElement so the whole app recalculates from the CSS-variable cascade.

relativeTime.description: Dates, said the way a person reading a chat would say them.

useAnchoredLayer.description: THE FLOATING-LAYER MECHANISM: a layer anchored to a trigger, kept in place while the page moves, and dismissed the two ways every such layer is.

useAutosave.description: Quiet period after the last change before a save is attempted.

useDismiss.description: THE TWO DISMISSALS every transient layer answers to: a press outside it, and Escape.

useFocusInside.description: FOCUS GOES INTO A LAYER WHEN IT OPENS, AND COMES BACK WHEN IT CLOSES.

useLatest.description: A ref that always holds the most recent value, for reading from a callback that outlives the render which created it.

useListKeys.description: DOWN, UP, HOME, END OVER A BOUNDED LIST — the smallest mechanism here, and the one three others were each rebuilding.

useListNavigation.description: AN ACTIVE ROW IN A LIST, MOVED BY THE KEYBOARD — the second mechanism this system had written more than once.

useMediaQuery.description: Subscribe to a CSS media query.

useRowSelection.description: The selection model a selectable table needs, in one place: which rows are picked, the tri-state of the header checkbox, and what "select all" means.

useSimpleFit.description: Does the whole "simple" list layout still fit on one screen? The rule it serves: a list page shows a centred welcome (hero title, the cards, one big CTA, no toolbar) while everything fits the viewport, and flips to the standard header layout the moment it outgrows it.

useTimer.description: ONE PENDING TIMEOUT, cleared before the next one and on unmount.

useTreeKeys.description: THE KEYBOARD OF A TREE — the third mechanism this system had written twice.

useUnsavedChanges.description: The guard an explicit-save form owes: while it is dirty, closing the tab or reloading asks first.
